attempts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single premium modular game backpack reference for Tripo 3D reconstruction. One complete standalone detachable wearable RADIO BACKPACK ONLY. Cozy sophisticated 3D animation-world product render, smooth sculpted rounded construction, painted enamel with fine chips, finely brushed aged brass with tiny screws and tactile patina, supple stitched leather and luminous translucent glass. High-end physically rendered materials, no low poly facets. Uniform light cool gray background, soft neutral studio lighting. Exact orthographic projection, no perspective, no three-quarter angle. Entire antenna, glass bulb and all harness straps inside square frame with generous even padding. No text, letters, logos or watermark. NO wearer, body, head, face, limbs, hands, feet, scarf, hat, mannequin, stand, or body-shaped shadows. ONE object only, all pieces physically connected. Harness is empty and wearable. Canonical BACK / outward decorated face, exact straight-on orthographic, no3/4. Ivory and amber OVAL radio backpack, warm satin-brass frame, oval dark outward speaker grille, two small caramel tuning knobs below, caramel leather shoulder harness. Clearly distinct from classic rectangular leather Lumen radio. Top ROTATING DEVICE is TWO compact elegant translucent cream-and-coral folding sail fins, one each side of ONE central brass articulated swivel mast. Each fin is a small swept rounded triangular wing with brass perimeter rim, connected to the same central moving yoke. One warm golden glass signal bulb atop center mast. Visible SINGLE central vertical-axis brass rotary bearing with exposed spindle and clearance above housing/shoulder loops: two wings and bulb rotate together on jump. No diagonal brace to body and no fixed second support. Both sail fins lie in WIDTH-HEIGHT plane parallel to broad oval housing face in symmetric rest position. Fin tips point gracefully up/out but remain compact. Central yoke lifted above highest shoulder loops to allow full yaw rotation; no part intersects or blocks rotary root. Make bearing mechanism beautiful and legible. Distinct compact DOUBLE-SAIL glider silhouette, not a single broad bow sail. No tail, no wearer. Source ref is crafted material reference ONLY. Entire object including both sails/bulb/empty shoulder straps inframe with even safe padding.
